scope: One bounded actual-source read-only contract/type/assertion review. No parser/engine/test execution or edits.
observations: Definitions and descriptors validate string key types before Codec.keys_error; validated flat shapes exclude cyclic/foreign values before defensive copies.
Recipe IDs are globally unique; every current profile points to a retained recipe of the same profile.
Restore validates saved retained recipe/profile/order independently of current mapping or preference.
Tampered/removed historical recipe assertions target refusal while their updated definitions remain valid.
Complete is set only after the normal assertion path, while every assertion row and first false row are retained.
verdict: No concrete contract, type or assertion defect found by source inspection; no parser/native correctness claim.
